text: 广汽集团公告，公司与一汽股份签署《意向协议》，拟发行股份购买一汽股份持有的某整车合资公司的部分股权并募集配套资金。本次交易尚处筹划阶段，预计构成重大资产重组及关联交易，不构成本公司实际控制人变更，不构成重组上市；公司A股自2026年9月14日开市起停牌，预计停牌时间不超过10个交易日。
text_en: GAC Group announced that the company signed a Letter of Intent with FAW, planning to issue shares to acquire part of the equity of a certain vehicle joint venture held by FAW and raise supporting funds. This transaction is still in the planning stage and is expected to constitute a major asset restructuring and a related-party transaction, will not constitute a change in the company's actual controller, and will not constitute a restructuring listing; the company's A-shares will be suspended from trading starting at market open on September 14, 2026, with the suspension expected to last no more than 10 trading days.
